Name: Furret - Dog replacement
Author: apoc500
Description:
Here's another Pokemon to add to your Stardew Valley farm! Furret runs, digs, pants, and sleeps. Well, and barks too.

Installation:

Navigate to your Stardew Valley Installation folder and copy file to:

Content\Animals

Don't forget to make a copy of the original dog.xnb file as a backup before overwriting (save the original to a different folder).

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
